entry.title: Julien added 'A Century of Hitchcock: The Man, the Myths, the Legacy'
entry.content: 📚 “A Century of Hitchcock: The Man, the Myths, the Legacy” by Tony Lee Moral ⭐️ Rated: 4/5 📝 "There is nothing left to convince me of Alfred Hitchcock’s genius or the complexities of his behavior. Tony Lee Moral’s book is simply proof in the pudding, and it never comes at Tippi Hedren’s expense. Exceptionally well researched and thoroughly documented, it is equally rewarding for seasoned Hitchcockians and readers looking for a deeper, more contemporary perspective on the Master’s life and work. That said, a few things did bother me. Moral occasionally takes unnecessary personal swipes at..." 🏷️ #TonyLeeMoral
